display.purpose: type-display: Young Serif 400, line-height 1.02, -0.015em, balanced wrap. Page h1s 60px (72px from sm, 84px Home hero); status views 48-60px; auth 60-72px; the coral elapsed counter 80-96px; the 27px wordmark. At most one word coral.

headline.purpose: Young Serif 20-30px: recommendation titles and dialog titles (24px), account-CTA titles (24-30px), preference group titles (20px), titles on generated covers (18px).

title.purpose: Outfit 600, 16px: book titles in grids, the active step label; field labels at 14px.

body.purpose: Outfit 400, 15px, relaxed leading, tabular figures on; recommendation reasons at 16px.

lede.purpose: Outfit 400, 17px muted line under every h1, max about 60ch.

label.purpose: type-label: Outfit 600, 12-13px, sentence case: badges, step states and counts.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Cards, the photo frame, the active step, and book cards on hover.

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Filled buttons (primary, danger); drops away on press.

shadows.name: shadow-sticker
shadows.purpose: Faint coral glow under peach stickers (upload, status icons).

shadows.name: cover-spine
shadows.purpose: Spine edge on every book cover.

shadows.name: read-line-glow
shadows.purpose: Soft coral glow on the 3px read-sweep line only.

motion.name: spring-layout
motion.purpose: Layout moves: nav pill, sort pill, author chips, re-sorted books, dialog and notice entrance.

motion.name: pop
motion.value: spring(stiffness 380, damping 22) from opacity 0, scale 0.95, y 12px; stagger 50-70ms
motion.purpose: Cards in grids and lists landing.

motion.name: button-lift
motion.purpose: Filled buttons; transition removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: read-progress
motion.purpose: Read rule while reading; static under reduced motion.

motion.name: read-sweep
motion.value: 2950ms loop (2.6s travel + 0.35s hold), cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1), phase-locked to wall clock
motion.purpose: Coral line and 55% ground veil over the photo while reading; hidden under reduced motion.

motion.name: cover-fade
motion.purpose: A loaded cover replacing its bookcloth binding.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Navy pill with a soft lift shadow for the main action; rises 1px on hover, settles 1px with no shadow on press. Also 36px (sm) and 52px (lg) sizes.

components.css: .ds-field { font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ded6c8); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-raised, #fffdf8); color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); font: 400 15px Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent, #23395d); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #23395d); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field-hint { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); }

components.css: .ds-nav { background: var(--color-ground, #f5f0e6); font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); } .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; height: 72px; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Young Serif', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 27px; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); } .ds-nav-link.is-active { background: var(--color-highlight, #f3c9b5); color: var(--color-highlight-ink, #1e2433); } .ds-nav-end { margin-left: auto; display: flex; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; background: var(--color-accent, #23395d); color: var(--color-accent-ink, #f5f0e6); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(30 36 51 / 0.18), 0 4px 12px rgb(35 57 93 / 0.18); } .ds-nav-btn-out { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ded6c8); background: var(--color-raised, #fffdf8); color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); box-shadow: none; } .ds-nav-btn-out:hover { border-color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); } .ds-nav-rule { height: 4px; background: var(--color-line, #ded6c8); } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #23395d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-book { width: 180px; padding: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ded6c8); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-raised, #fffdf8); font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--color-ink, #1e2433); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-book:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(30 36 51 / 0.05), 0 8px 22px rgb(30 36 51 / 0.07); } .ds-cover { aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px; border-radius: 10px; background: #6e8b74; color: #1e2433; box-shadow: inset -6px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); transition: transform 300ms ease-out; } .ds-book:hover .ds-cover { transform: translateY(-4px) rotate(-1deg); } .ds-cover-title { font-family: 'Young Serif', Georgia, serif; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.015em; hyphens: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; } .ds-cover-author { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; opacity: 0.85; } .ds-book-title { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-book-author { margin: 2px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); } .ds-book-tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; } .ds-badge, .ds-tag { border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge { background: var(--color-highlight, #f3c9b5); color: var(--color-highlight-ink, #1e2433); transform: rotate(-2deg); } .ds-badge-low { background: transparent; color: var(--color-accent, #23395d); border: 1px dashed currentColor; transform: rotate(1deg); } .ds-tag { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #ded6c8); color: var(--color-ink-muted, #5f6677); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-cover { transition: none; } .ds-book:hover .ds-cover { transform: none; } }

components.name: Read Rule
components.description: Signature: the 4px hairline under the nav. While a page reads (useReading(true)), a navy-to-coral fill eases from 0 toward 92% over 14s and waits; static under reduced motion. Shown here in the reading state.
components.css: .ds-read-rule { position: relative; width: 420px; height: 4px; background: var(--color-line, #ded6c8); } .ds-read-fill { position: absolute; inset: 0; transform-origin: left; border-radius: 0 9999px 9999px 0; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--color-accent, #23395d), var(--color-coral, #d2603f)); animation: ds-read-progress 14s cubic-bezier(0.1, 0.6, 0.3, 1) forwards; } @keyframes ds-read-progress { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(0.92); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-read-fill { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A well-made paperback, not a dashboard. Warm cream paper, navy ink, one soft peach highlight, and a single coral detail. The interface is calm so the books (real covers, or generated bookcloth covers) carry the colour. Headings are set in Young Serif, a sturdy bookish serif; everything you read or operate is set in Outfit, a clean geometric sans.

The friendliness comes from shape, not from hue. Controls are full pills. Content sits on cream-white cards with hairline borders and soft, ink-tinted shadows. A few tilted "stickers" (the upload icon, status icons, confidence badges) add a hand-placed touch without adding colours.

There is one signature effect, and it only appears while work is happening. The hairline under the nav becomes a navy-to-coral progress rule, and a single coral scan line crosses the shelf photo.
keyCharacteristics: Cream ground, navy ink and accent, peach highlight, coral reserved for large display words and the read line.
Young Serif display (one weight) and Outfit UI; tabular figures everywhere.
Pill buttons; 16px cards, 20px photo frame and stickers, 10px covers, 24px dialog.
Soft tinted shadows (`shadow-card`, `shadow-lift`, `shadow-sticker`); no hard offset shadows, no ink outlines.
A plain hairline under the nav that becomes the reading progress bar.
Light and dark follow the OS (`prefers-color-scheme`); reduced motion follows the OS.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Navy is the only colour that means "you can press this" or "selected". Peach is emphasis, coral is a detail. Do not add a fourth hue to the chrome.

rules.name: The Untinted Cover Rule
rules.body: Covers are shown as delivered: no overlays, tints, duotones or filters. A missing cover is bound in bookcloth with the title in the display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: `tabular-nums` is set on the body, so counts, percentages, timings and sizes always align.

dos: **Do** keep the chrome to paper, ink, navy, peach and the occasional coral word.
**Do** call `useReading(true)` from a page while it waits on slow work, so the rule under the nav shows progress.
**Do** set page h1s in Young Serif with a 17px muted lede beneath, and colour at most one word coral.
**Do** use pills for controls, 16–20px cards for content, and soft tinted shadows for depth.
**Do** use Lucide icons (1.75–2 stroke); no inline SVG.
**Do** animate only transform and opacity, and give every looping effect a reduced-motion fallback.
**Do** check every new colour pair in both light and dark mode (AA: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for large text).
donts: **Don't** tint, overlay or filter book covers.
**Don't** add more brights: no rainbow palettes, multicolour chips or candy-coloured covers.
**Don't** use coral for text under 24px, or as a control fill.
**Don't** use a violet or aubergine dark mode; dark mode is navy-black.
**Don't** put a decorative band or graphic under the nav; the rule is a hairline until something is reading.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or thick ink outlines (the rejected "chunky playful" direction).
